value.rationale: The theorem resolves two natural sharp transport questions under a physically motivated local return protocol: whether any drift survives when return events vanish (alpha=1) and whether the near-zero return response is differentiable (alpha=3). Both logarithmic critical laws and exact fractional constants give precise predictions across an entire iid-disorder family, not a routine finite-case calculation or a reused theorem title.
